This is the course deadline list as of September 23. I'll update it when later problem sets or walkthroughs are scheduled. A date without a time is listed that way in the syllabus; don't assume it means 10:00 AM.

| Date and time | Work due or scheduled |
|---|---|
| Thursday, September 10 | Paper repository and one-paragraph topic statement in its README. |
| Tuesday, September 22 | Project materials in hand: raw data committed or documented if unshareable, and a working first cleaning script. For a data-light project, acquire and organize the essential sources or other materials. |
| **Tuesday, September 29, 10:00 AM** | **Problem Set 01:** commit and push `Psets/pset-01/pset-01.qmd`. |
| **Thursday, October 1, 10:00 AM** | **One-page project plan:** question, materials, intended analyses, and outputs. Request approval here if your project needs an alternative to the default data pipeline, first figure, or dashboard. |
| Tuesday, October 6 | Paper skeleton renders to PDF with a managed `.bib`, at least three real citations, and a first figure or approved equivalent. |
| Tuesday, October 13 | CV and minimal website both render. Public deployment and a public CV link are optional. |
| Thursday, October 29, in class | Part I midterm practical (AI off). |
| **Tuesday, November 3, 10:00 AM** | **Dashboard problem set** (AI off). Its assignment file will give the details. |
| Thursday, November 5 | First real project result: your pipeline runs end-to-end on your materials and produces a result or approved equivalent. |
| Tuesday, November 10, before class | AI Critique 1: the written submission from the November 5 scraper lab. |
| Thursday, November 19 | Diagnostic repository check: your pipeline runs from a clean clone and a full draft renders. |
| Tuesday, December 1 | Last day for no-penalty corrections to reproducibility problems found in the November 19 check, provided you made a good-faith complete attempt at that check. |
| Thursday, December 3 | AI Critique 2: your own eval, a mini leaderboard, and a memo. |
| Monday, December 14, 2:00–4:00 PM | Final practical and project presentations during the exam period. The final paper, reproducible repository, dashboard or approved alternative, AI-use statement, and updated CV and website are due that day. |

## Deadlines that recur

- **In-class workbooks:** commit and push the whole workbook before leaving class. If you couldn't finish or render, push your saved work and record the error.
- **Later problem sets:** unless an assignment gives a later date, they are due at 10:00 AM on the day of the next class. Their individual dates will be added above when assigned.
- **Problem-set walkthroughs:** I will tell you which submitted problem we'll discuss before your scheduled walkthrough.
